description: Ensure a single, always-on global heartbeat wake-up schedule exists. Idempotent: creates the heartbeat if missing, normalizes duplicates if found. The heartbeat is global infrastructure (not session-bound) that enables periodic check-ins, stuck-work detection, and async job delivery.
embedding_description: Ensure a single global heartbeat wake-up exists (keep-alive / liveness). Idempotent: safe to call on first user message after startup. Prevents silent comas by guaranteeing periodic wake-ups. Not session-bound; uses memory_tag conventions like heartbeat:global.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Heartbeat status including whether it was created, already present, or normalized (duplicate cleanup), plus schedule identifiers and cadence details
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: A global heartbeat wake-up has been ensured. If you are implementing responsiveness patterns, you can now rely on periodic wake-ups to drive check-ins and follow-up processing.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Ensuring a single global heartbeat wake-up schedule exists
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ParameterError: invalid cadence_minutes (must be 1-59). ExecutionError: scheduling service unavailable or failed to create/update the schedule.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: If scheduling is unavailable, fall back to user-driven check-ins. If validation fails, use a safe default cadence and the recommended heartbeat:global tag convention.
